Text:
One single continuous photograph — no panels, grids, or split frames.

Use the uploaded photo as the exact base composition. The street in the source
is empty — populate it with the people and vehicles specified below. Remove all
modern businesses, logos, brands, storefront names, banners, advertisements, and
signage visible in the source image.

PRESERVE (must match source exactly)
- camera: eye-level, street-facing, fov 78
- commercial arterial road, 4-lane, asphalt
- sidewalks present, curbs present
- driveways: north entrance apron, south entrance apron; parking: large front asphalt lot with painted stalls
- single-story retail row under a continuous overhang building at along the back of the lot, 1 story, brick veneer, EIFS stucco panels, flat with continuous overhang roof, 60 feet from road setback
- detached end-cap retail unit building at north end of the lot, 1 story, brick veneer, metal fascia panels, flat parapet roof, 40 feet from road setback
- utilities: overhead power lines on wooden poles, transformer on rear property line pole
- landscape: parking lot islands with curbing, landscape strip along the road frontage, painted stall striping
- immutable elements: continuous storefront overhang along the retail row, pylon sign base at the road frontage, parking lot islands
Keep this location instantly recognizable.

OUTPUT FORMAT
Create a TRUE 9:16 vertical portrait. Expand the SAME scene naturally above
(sky) and below (street/pavement) as canvas extension — do not stretch or
distort the source geometry.

TRANSFORM TO 1975
Post-Vietnam, oil crisis era. A brand-new mid-1970s strip mall — one low row of shops under a mansard-shingle canopy, fronted by an open parking lot.

CONDITION: thriving — well-maintained, freshly painted, active business, clean lot

PERIOD DETAILS
- soft-serve ice cream stand at the end cap with a cone-shaped sign
- small 'A&P' style grocery with stacked shopping carts by the door
- laundromat with an 'OPEN 24 HOURS' sign and washers visible through the plate glass
- window signs: 'GRAND OPENING', '8-TRACK TAPES $4.99'
- a telephone booth at the edge of the parking lot
- a row of nested shopping carts near the grocery entrance
Typography: bold sans-serif, slab serif, occasional script.
Sign text is only what appears in quotes — do not turn other words from this prompt into signage.

PEOPLE
EXACTLY 16 people TOTAL: 6 near sidewalk (largest, foreground), 6 opposite sidewalk mid-block, 4 distant, far end of block. Grouped in pairs, threes, and singles.
- a workman in uniform carrying a toolbox to his truck
- a woman carrying a laundry basket under the canopy
- a man in a work uniform on a lunch break
Clothing: men in bell bottoms, plaid patterns; women in earth tones, midi skirts. No posing or eye contact. All people stay on sidewalks, at storefronts, or beside parked vehicles — never standing, sitting, or walking in the road or driving lanes.

VEHICLES
EXACTLY 5 period vehicles, all different:
- 1963-1976 Dodge Dart — compact, boxy, reliable workhorse
- 1970-1976 AMC Hornet — compact, simple boxy lines
- 1974-1978 Oldsmobile Cutlass Supreme — best-selling car in America, formal roofline
- 1971-1976 Chevrolet G10 Sportvan — boxy windowed van, chrome bumper
- 1975-1993 Volvo 240 — boxy Swedish sedan/wagon, safety-forward design
Parked with gaps; no vehicle newer than 1975.
Parked vehicles hug the curb — parallel, each facing its lane's direction; none sideways, diagonal, or against traffic. Keep at least one full driving lane clear each way for through traffic.
PLACEMENT: all parked on the RIGHT side of the street with gaps between them. No vehicle in the same spot as any other era.

ENVIRONMENT
- road markings: yellow center line, white edge lines, no rumble strips
- utilities: overhead power lines everywhere, wooden utility poles standard

TREES
- crepe myrtle tree at parking lot island near entrance: very young sapling
- maple tree at landscape strip along the road: very young sapling
- oak tree at back property line: very young sapling
Tree sizes MUST follow this specification even where they differ from the source photo.

PHOTOGRAPHIC STYLE
STRICTLY BLACK AND WHITE — true monochrome archival photograph, zero color anywhere.
Grain: visible fine grain. Style: documentary, natural light.
Photorealistic, like a preserved newspaper-archive frame; slight period-lens softness, not digitally sharp.

PRIVACY
Blur all faces and license plates.
